title: UniDPP Terminology
subtitle: Digital Product Passport — Terminology (UniDPP working dataset)
description: Digital Product Passport vocabulary harvested from EN 18216–18246:2026, CWA 18291:2025 and IDTA 01001-3.2, with proposed UniDPP framework terms; the single source of truth for the proposed ISO 25534-1 Part 1 (Vocabulary) draft.

eng.description:
Digital Product Passport terminology harvested from the
EN 18216–18246:2026 terms-and-definitions clauses, CWA 18291:2025
and IDTA 01001-3.2, plus framework terms proposed by UniDPP and
marked as such. Working dataset; the single source of truth for
the proposed ISO 25534-1 Part 1 (Vocabulary) draft.
eng.title: UniDPP working dataset — Digital Product Passport Terminology
